plan.calibration: One new uniform neutral spectrum [1,1]; fixed gains before development and holdout
plan.color_reference: clear-e2-g1, relative RAW ratios; not absolute color accuracy
plan.input: Uniform shared radiance derived from archived per-band spatial means, multiplied by a moving sinusoid in the fixed original native window
plan.timing: Global box shutter centered at common relative time zero; not two different poses or rolling shutter
plan.prior_holdouts: Not reused; earlier results are development context, not fresh confirmation
plan.limits_note: Authored research brief; not customer specifications or identified hardware support
